faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Have questions before bringing KhamarBari to your sheds and ponds? We have you covered.

items.question: Does KhamarBari work in rural areas with slow or intermittent internet?
items.answer: Yes, absolutely. KhamarBari is built with an offline-resilient architecture. Your managers and farmhands can log milk yields, feed distribution, and sales even when mobile data drops. Everything automatically syncs to the central cloud the moment connectivity returns.

items.question: Can farm workers with limited tech literacy use the app easily?
items.answer: Yes. We designed the interface in clear, authentic Bangla alongside English. Daily routine inputs like logging 20 liters of milk or marking a worker present take just two taps with big, self-explanatory icons.

items.question: Can I export reports for bank loans and government livestock subsidies?
items.answer: Yes! KhamarBari generates one-click audited P&L statements, livestock valuation certificates, and inventory summaries in PDF and Excel (CSV) formatted specifically to meet Bangladesh commercial bank and DLS standards.

items.question: How many branches or farm locations can I connect?
items.answer: You can manage from 1 family farm shed up to dozens of branch locations across different districts. Each branch can have its own local supervisor while the owner monitors consolidated revenue from one central screen.

items.question: How does the 14-day free trial work?
items.answer: You get unrestricted access to every single feature, including multi-branch support, animal records, and automated exports. No credit card or prepayment is required. You can start in less than 2 minutes.
